title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - InternetExchangePoint
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/InternetExchangePoint. Physical infrastructure allowing participants to interconnect their networks hence avoiding the use of upstream provider networks. IXPs are usually non-profit as the interconnected participants agree to share free transit. Subclass of PhysicalInterconnectionPointIdentifier per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PhysicalInterconnectionPointIdentifier model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'InternetExchangePoint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

interconnectedParticipants.description: Relationship. Internet service providers interconnecting their networks through this IXP. Links to one or more InternetServiceProvider entities.
